title: you will never ask about pointers again after watching this video
educational_value: Unravels the mystery of pointers with visual memory representation and address dereferencing.
missing_concepts: Does not cover function pointers or volatile qualifiers.

title: you can learn assembly in 10 minutes (try it RIGHT NOW)
educational_value: Fast, high-impact overview of registers, load/store instructions, and assembly execution.
missing_concepts: Does not cover ARM Thumb-2 specific dual-instruction width or IT blocks.

title: Understanding and Using Function Pointers in C
educational_value: Explains syntax, function pointer tables, callback architectures, and dynamic dispatching in C.
missing_concepts: Does not discuss hardware interrupt vector tables.

title: Are Pointers Bad for Embedded Systems?
educational_value: Addresses real-world trade-offs, pointer arithmetic, memory bounds, and defensive embedded pointer usage.
missing_concepts: Does not cover peripheral base address typecasting (`(GPIO_TypeDef*)`).

title: How to use the volatile keyword in C?
educational_value: Demonstrates compiler optimization bugs when reading hardware registers and shows why volatile is mandatory.
missing_concepts: Does not cover memory barrier instructions (DMB, DSB, ISB).

title: Struct packing: No, you're not going crazy.
educational_value: Visually proves 32-bit boundary alignment, packing pragmas, and padding overhead in C structs.
missing_concepts: Does not cover bitfield endianness issues across different compilers.

title: Structs in C | What you Need to Know
educational_value: Comprehensive overview of defining, initializing, and accessing structs and pointers to structs.
missing_concepts: Focuses on desktop C rather than hardware register struct overlays.

title: STM32 Short #11 - EXCITING C feature - Bit Fields (or  bit packing)
educational_value: Shows how bitfields map directly to MCU peripheral register fields.
missing_concepts: Does not cover non-atomic read-modify-write hazards with bitfields.

title: Bistable 555 - 8-bit computer clock - part 3
educational_value: Builds intuition for astable clock circuits, clock gating, and synchronization.
missing_concepts: Uses 555 discrete logic rather than integrated PLL clock trees.

title: Testing our computer's registers - 8-bit register - Part 5
educational_value: Physical demonstration of tri-state buffers, register output enable, and bus routing.
missing_concepts: Focuses on 8-bit architecture rather than 32-bit ARM Cortex-M bus matrices.

title: Embedded Systems Programming Lesson 2  Flow of Control
educational_value: Steps into assembly in the debugger to show branch instructions, condition codes, and the PC register.
missing_concepts: Does not discuss hardware branch prediction or pipelining in advanced Cortex-M.

title: #3 Variables and Pointers
educational_value: Maps C local and static variables to RAM addresses and processor registers.
missing_concepts: Does not cover heap allocation or dynamic memory managers.

title: #4 How to control the world outside?
educational_value: Connects schematic pinouts to datasheet memory maps and writes to GPIO registers in debugger.
missing_concepts: Uses TivaC Launchpad as hardware demo; register offsets differ from STM32.

title: #6 Bit-wise operators in C
educational_value: Deep dive into AND, OR, XOR, NOT, shift operators and their assembly counterparts.
missing_concepts: Does not cover BSRR atomic bit set/reset registers available in STM32.

title: #7 Arrays and Pointer Arithmetic
educational_value: Explains machine-level pointer scaling (`sizeof`) and mapping consecutive register blocks.
missing_concepts: Does not discuss DMA multi-buffer pointer indexing.

title: #10 Stack Overflow and Other Pitfalls of Functions
educational_value: Dissects function activation records, stack frames, SP, LR, and detecting stack overflow bugs.
missing_concepts: Does not cover MPU (Memory Protection Unit) hardware stack protection.

title: STM32 Bare Metal Tutorial: Creating Your First Project & LED Blink  | STM32 Bare Metal Tutorial #1
educational_value: Zero-library bare-metal bootstrap from scratch with Makefile and direct register writes.
missing_concepts: Does not include CMSIS header definitions (uses manual address `#define`).

title: STM32 Clock and High Speed External Crystal (HSE) | STM32 Bare Metal Tutorial #3
educational_value: Shows register-level clock switching from internal RC oscillator to external crystal and PLL.
missing_concepts: Configured for STM32F4/F1; STM32G4 requires Boost mode voltage scaling above 150MHz.

title: STM32 Bare Metal Library | STM32 Bare Metal Tutorial #4
educational_value: Guides structuring register definitions into clean, reusable driver headers.
missing_concepts: Does not follow full CMSIS-Core coding standard.

title: Bare metal peripheral from scratch and advanced register debugging - STM32 Bare Metal #6
curriculum_subtopic: SVD Register Debugging in VS Code
educational_value: Demonstrates loading System View Description (SVD) XML files into VS Code Cortex-Debug.
missing_concepts: Does not cover ITM / SWO tracing.

title: Bit-banging PWM - STM32 Bare Metal #9
educational_value: Demonstrates software timing limitations and why hardware timer PWM peripherals are essential.
missing_concepts: Does not use hardware timer capture/compare registers.

title: Timer with Interrupt - Bare Metal #8
educational_value: Configures prescaler, auto-reload register, and interrupt generation without blocking the CPU.
missing_concepts: Does not cover timer synchronization or master/slave trigger modes.

title: How to use External Interrupts - STM32 Tutorial #6
educational_value: Step-by-step routing of GPIO pin through SYSCFG to EXTI line and NVIC IRQ handling.
missing_concepts: Does not cover software-triggered interrupts or event generation mode.

title: STM32 UART Bare Metal | Hello, World! (Getting Started)
educational_value: Calculates baud rate divisor, configures GPIO alternate functions, and transmits bytes over serial.
missing_concepts: Does not cover interrupt-driven or DMA UART reception.

title: STM32 Bare Metal GPIO Analog Input Tutorial | No HAL, No Libraries | STM32F401
educational_value: Shows how to configure GPIO MODER bits for analog mode to disable digital input buffers.
missing_concepts: Does not configure the ADC conversion sequence or sample time.

title: STM32 Bare-Metal: Configure Clocks Without HAL
educational_value: Deep walkthrough of RCC registers, flash wait states, and PLL configuration on Cortex-M.
missing_concepts: Specific to STM32L4; G474 requires PWR_CR5 boost mode setting.

title: STM32 ADC Full Course: From Basics to Advanced (DMA, Timer, Injected, Oversampling)
educational_value: Exhaustive treatment of single-shot, scan, continuous, timer-triggered, and DMA ADC modes.
missing_concepts: Uses HAL implementation; concepts must be translated to direct registers.

title: Lecture 15: Booting Process
educational_value: Authoritative explanation of the power-on reset sequence, SP loading from 0x00000000, and Reset_Handler.
missing_concepts: Does not cover dual-bank boot or option byte configuration.

title: Module 2 _18EC62_ARM Cortex M3 Instruction Sets and Programming
educational_value: Deep academic lecture on ARMv7-M 16/32-bit Thumb-2 instructions, pipeline, and condition flags.
missing_concepts: Does not provide hands-on GCC build workflow.

title: STM32G4 & Real Time DSP: Part 1 Introduction to the STM32 Family and STM32G4
educational_value: Comprehensive introduction to the STM32G4 series: Cordic, FMAC, HRTIM, analog peripherals, and pinouts.
missing_concepts: High-level overview without code.

title: STM32G4 & Real Time DSP: Part 2 Blinky Tutorial, Digital Functions, and Debugging.
educational_value: First hands-on code on STM32G4 Nucleo board, clock initialization, and debugging tools.
missing_concepts: Uses IDE auto-generation for initial setup.

title: STM32G4 & Real Time DSP: Part 3 Timers, Execution Time, Non-Blocking Delays, Interrupts, and PWM
educational_value: Calculates timer frequencies, implements non-blocking delays, and generates hardware PWM on G4.
missing_concepts: Does not cover HRTIM (High Resolution Timer).

title: STM32G4 & Real Time DSP: Part 4 ADC, Polling, Direct Memory Access, Timer Triggered Conversions
educational_value: Directly targets STM32G4 fast ADCs, timer triggering, and DMA circular transfer.
missing_concepts: Uses HAL wrappers; bare-metal register mapping must be applied.

title: STM32G4 & Real Time DSP: Part 5 ADC to DAC with DSP, Multiplication, Addition, and Time Delays
curriculum_subtopic: STM32G4 ADC to DAC DSP Loopback
educational_value: Builds a complete analog pipeline: ADC sampling -> DSP math -> DAC output in real time.
missing_concepts: Does not cover analog comparator integration.

title: STM32G4 & Real Time DSP: Part 6 Using the CMSIS DSP Library
educational_value: Integrates official ARM CMSIS-DSP library on STM32G4 for real-time digital filtering and convolution.
missing_concepts: Does not explore hardware Cordic/FMAC accelerators in G4.

title: STM32F4 Bare-Metal Lab: SPI & I2C Protocol Implementation (BME280)
educational_value: Register-level comparison and implementation of SPI and I2C protocols reading a BME280 sensor.
missing_concepts: Focuses on STM32F4; G4 I2C has advanced TIMINGR register calculation.

title: STM32 Bare-Metal Programming: Interfacing the ICM-20948 Over SPI
educational_value: Practical bare-metal SPI driver writing, clock polarity/phase selection, and sensor register reading.
missing_concepts: Does not use DMA for SPI data transfer.

title: STM32 I2C device Driver Part 2 || Bare Metal || SCL ||SDA ||
educational_value: Low-level driver construction covering START, 7-bit address, ACK check, and STOP generation.
missing_concepts: Does not cover I2C SMBus or multimaster arbitration.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 1 - What is a Real-Time Operating System (RTOS)? | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Clear conceptual breakdown of why RTOS is needed, preemptive scheduling, and real-time deadlines.
missing_concepts: Theory only; coding starts in Part 2.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 2 - Getting Started with FreeRTOS | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Teaches `xTaskCreate`, task parameters, priority assignments, and FreeRTOS project setup.
missing_concepts: Does not cover static task memory allocation (`xTaskCreateStatic`).

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 3 - Task Scheduling | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Visualizes tick interrupts, round-robin scheduling, task states (Ready, Running, Blocked, Suspended).
missing_concepts: Does not show the low-level PendSV assembly context switch handler.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 4 - Memory Management | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Examines FreeRTOS heap implementations (heap_1 to heap_5), stack overflow hook functions.
missing_concepts: Does not cover MPU-based memory isolation between tasks.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 5 - Queue | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Mastery of `xQueueCreate`, `xQueueSend`, `xQueueReceive` for safe thread communication.
missing_concepts: Does not cover zero-copy queue passing using pointers.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 6 - Mutex | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Explains mutual exclusion, shared resources, race conditions, and `xSemaphoreCreateMutex`.
missing_concepts: Does not cover recursive mutexes.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 7 - Semaphore | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Differentiates mutex ownership from semaphore signaling and task synchronization.
missing_concepts: Does not cover event flags / event groups.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 8 - Software Timer | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Shows how to create one-shot and periodic software timers managed by FreeRTOS daemon task.
missing_concepts: Does not compare software timer jitter with hardware timer interrupts.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 9 - Hardware Interrupts | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Critical lesson on calling RTOS primitives from hardware ISRs using `xQueueSendFromISR` and deferred interrupt processing.
missing_concepts: Does not discuss ARM Cortex-M `configMAX_SYSCALL_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY` configuration.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 10 - Deadlock and Starvation | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Demonstrates dining philosophers problem, circular wait conditions, and deadlock avoidance.
missing_concepts: Does not cover formal verification of concurrent systems.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 11 - Priority Inversion | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Deep explanation of the Mars Pathfinder priority inversion bug and how priority inheritance fixes it.
missing_concepts: Does not discuss priority ceiling protocol.

title: Introduction to RTOS Part 12 - Multicore Systems | Digi-Key Electronics
educational_value: Explains dual-core scheduling, core affinity, and inter-processor communication.
missing_concepts: Cortex-M4 on G474RE is single core; provides general architectural knowledge.
